supported_claims: Antithetic covariance may be negative, zero, or positive depending on integrand.
For the frozen four level sets and fixed equal function evaluation counts, the antithetic to IID variance ratios are 0, 2/3, or 2.
Finite full exact PMFs, means, variances, and MSEs match an independent convolution and covariance formulas.
limitations: Only artificial four-value uniform sample spaces are studied.
No actual stochastic Monte Carlo draws or empirical evidence.
No assertion of universal variance reduction or real psychology/history predictive validity.
